hook: She owes her sister more than she can ever repay.

excerpt.text: Nadia’s last text to me was fourteen months old. It said: Please stop.
Thirty-four payments. Six thousand pounds still to go.
It was never legally hers to pay. She paid it anyway.

caption:
Ava needs the money. So when a stranger offers four thousand pounds for three weeks of house-sitting, she doesn’t ask why.
